mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ticket(public_id, customer_id, session_public_id, source_action_id, subject, description) VALUES(#{publicId},#{customerId},#{sessionId},#{actionId},#{subject},#{description})
mapper.select: SELECT public_id, subject, description, status, created_at FROM ticket WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT public_id, subject, description, status, created_at FROM ticket WHERE source_action_id=#{actionId} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT FROM ticket t JOIN customer c ON c.id=t.customer_id WHERE t.status=#{status} ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET status=#{targetStatus}, assigned_to=COALESCE(assigned_to,#{operator}), resolution_note=CASE WHEN #{resolutionNote} IS NULL OR #{resolutionNote}='' THEN resolution_note ELSE #{resolutionNote} END WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND status=#{currentStatus}
